_meta.provenance_policy: Every value carries provenance: 'sourced' (citation attached; bureau/primary or corroborated carrier source) or 'verify' (value present but resting on a secondary source or unconfirmed pairing — the engine applies it and surfaces it in the VERIFY queue). Values that change by policy year are stored as 'vintages' resolved by POLICY EFFECTIVE DATE; a policy effective before the earliest known vintage resolves to none and routes to human review.
_meta.scope: Workers' compensation premium audit rules. GL audit rules land in v2.
_meta.changelog: 2.0.0: real officer/sole-prop tables for 10 states from Aug 25 2026 research (NYCIRB RC 2659, WCIRB regulatory filings, PCRB Quick Reference/Circular 1813, NJCRIB via PIA, WCRB misc values, FSIGA, TDI/Texas Mutual, ICW Group carrier chart for DE/IL/GA pending bureau-direct confirmation). CORRECTION: prior NY values ($1,700/$3,400 wk, $89,200 flat) were refuted by NYCIRB RC 2659 and replaced.
